One player, claude-opus-5-5 effort medium (Claude Code 2.1.283), over all three seats with no commander role; hands Jev jev-latest = jev-1.13.0 on every seat (banner names MonkeyLord, Rikerss).

summary: Three Opus-led seats against Infern8 (lobby 25, Cortex) on Comet Catcher, lost at about 17:05 with two commanders dead. The side out-expanded him (30 extractors at 8:00 against 9 ever seen) but kept a mostly light army at home as pickets. It killed one building of his in the game's first 16 minutes, and he walked his commander forward to D4 with a second plant, a light turret, Brutes and, from 8:29, Pounders. The player gathered the three seats for 90 s and ordered one attack at 8:14. Each seat's hands priced its own group alone, so the seats went in one after another and about 80 soldiers (10.2k) fell to 24 for about 3.5k of his. After that, reading a trade line that counted every kill three times, the player held and rebuilt: one good fight at 12:08 (18 Brutes), then his single block of Pounders and Brutes beat dark blue's lone group at 13:04 and took dark blue's home by 14:28 and purple's by 16:18, while up to 14k of wrecks lay unreclaimed and the advanced plant begun at 10:16 never finished; the distinct trade was 24.4k of his for about 50k of ours.

root.what: His commander and a new forward plant were found at D4 just after his Incisors died (6 at 6:35). We had about 7k of soldiers, 60 of 78 of them light, against one person. The player chose to gather all three seats at a place in our half (spot_32, then spot_27 further back at 7:38), to wait until all three were there, and to make the commander the target. For 90 s he added Brutes, a light turret and Pounders. The three seats' hands could not form one body, so the 8:14 attack went in as three (reader's reading of the cause; the clock and the cost come from the tools).
root.evidence: 6:45 note: 'enemy commander forward at D4 with a second plant ... Gathering all three raider groups (~6.4k) at spot_32 to attack_unit the commander together.' Records at 8:20: t1 29, t2 28, t3 21 soldiers at x5829-6003 (10.2k); 9:30: 10/5/9 (4.5k).

our_mistakes.what: No pressure. Each plant made raiders only, the raiders stood as home pickets, and the one raid was ordered at 3:59. In 16 minutes the side killed one building of his (an extractor at B5, 2:18), so a lone person kept an untouched economy. A stronger player sends the first handful across the map and hits his outer extractors (pool: first building killed at 2:48).
our_mistakes.evidence: pro_baseline t1 --all-starts: 'first building of his killed - | pool 2:18 2:48 4:13'; distinct kills: buildings only cormex 2:18 (B5) and cormex 16:43; side army at 4:00-8:00 0-6% in his half (records).

our_mistakes.what: A gather in our half, held until all three groups had arrived, with his commander in a defended forward block as the target. The 90 s let him add Pounders and a turret. With three seats that could not move as one, a stronger choice was to go now or around: three lanes at his naked extractors, not the strongest point on the map.
our_mistakes.evidence: 6:45 instruct: 'When group_A_t1, group_A_t2 and group_A_t3 all stand at spot_32 together: every group attacks the enemy commander'; 7:38 moved to spot_27; corlevlr first seen 8:29 D4.

our_mistakes.what: The army was light raiders into Pounders. At 8:20, 60 of the side's 78 armed units were Incisors, Blitzes and scout cars, and line tanks had been ordered only from 6:18. Against his Pounders and Brutes the light mass traded badly.

their_play: Infern8 played Cortex vehicles from one plant at B4, with a nano turret by 2:36 and Incisors from 2:36; his radar stood at C4 by 4:03. Unpressured, he walked his commander forward to D4 with a second vehicle plant and a light turret (6:38-6:48), added Brutes and, from 8:29, Pounders, and held D4 as one block with the commander inside. Through the attack of 8:35-9:20 the block lost about 3.5k and stayed together. He then raided with Brutes: 7-9 into our north at 10:05-10:33 (6 extractors) and Brutes with Pounders into the south-middle at 10:55-11:44. He kept one main block (about 34 contacts on radar at E3/E4 at 14:01; 13 Pounders and 15 Brutes at F2/F3 at 14:45) and moved it from seat to seat: dark blue's home at 13:43-14:28, then north to purple's at 14:41-16:18. From 15:02 his Graverobbers raised our wrecks at F5/F6, and Reapers (tier 2) were in sight at 17:00. Over the game we saw 66 Brutes, 40 Pounders and 13 Incisors of his, but only 9 extractors. No building of his base died after 2:18, and the D4 plant never died.

bears_on.note: The seats fought one at a time twice: at D4 (t1 8:40-8:53, t3 8:50-9:00, t2 9:10-9:20) and again at 13:04-14:16 (dark blue's Brutes alone while teal's Pounders were stuck). His one block beat both. Here a since-fixed defect drove it: each seat priced its own group alone.
At 8:20, 60 of our 78 armed units were light (31 Incisors, 19 Blitzes, 10 scout cars), and they died into his Pounders and Brutes at D4. The ledger: 'he went Pounders and Brutes early'.
Raiders stood as home pickets. Apart from an extractor at 2:18, nothing of his died before 16:43, and the lone person built a forward plant at D4 unharassed.
The same lesson against another person: our economic lead (30 extractors against 9 seen at 8:00) went unused while his economy and forward plant were never raided.
'I would go around rather than attack the strongest position.' The attack went head-on into his commander, light turret and Pounders at D4, for 9.6k lost against 3.5k.

Infern8, this game's opponent, said the next day that defences are strong per metal and need range or overwhelming force. Here his LLT and commander at D4 anchored a block that light raiders could not break.
This is a rematch of game 5, which was won by converging on him. Here the lead (9.3k of soldiers at 8:00, all at F4) was held at home until 8:24 and then spent on the strongest point.
From 10:00, 3.5k to 12k of wrecks lay in our half with 0 constructors at work. His Graverobbers raised them at F5/F6 from 15:02.
No seat built a construction turret all game. Purple's advanced plant, started at 10:16, was still unfinished when it died at 16:05.
The advanced plant came late (started at 10:16, the first of the six games per the ledger) and never finished. His Reapers were in sight at 17:00.
The player made his commander the target (6:45-8:14). The words had no rule to land in, and the commander lived.

lens.existing_review: none (no review.md; /ceph/christian/within-reason/run/matches-archive/1790475913-bluegecko-3v1-comet-catcher-6/00/posing-review.md and decompression-review.md were read)
lens.caveats: No review.md exists, but 00/posing-review.md and 00/decompression-review.md (model reviews, 2026-09-27) were read and built on. I agree with their D4 finding and add the gather delay, the light composition and the absent pressure as causes upstream of it. I differ from the ledger's 'purple attacked his D4 block alone at 7:38': as posing-review.md says, those were raiders fed forward (471 lost for 0), and the costly entry came at 8:35-8:54. The per-match tools read only record-0 and jev-0 (seat t1). Seats t2 and t3 were read through symlinked scratch dirs; a first attempt used a scratch dir another reader had populated, and those outputs were discarded. There is no truth file, so his army and extractor counts are floors, minutes.py's 12:00-15:00 'windows' rest on a block that was out of sight, and his tier-2 timing is unknown. pro_baseline needed --all-starts (no G1 card) and compares one seat with a 1v1 pool. raid_ledger's 'answered 0' is a tool fault with seat-tagged party names (as posing-review.md notes). The chat holds no computer_whisperer line and no advice: the only person line, at 1:59, is unattributed ('Claude: how does this handle unicode?').

open_questions: How many extractors did he really hold? Only 9 were ever seen, and the posing review estimates about 24k of soldiers fielded by 15:00, which is more than 8 extractors pay for. Reclaim is unaccounted.
When did his tier 2 start? Reapers were first seen at 17:00, and there is no truth file.
Would an immediate strike at 6:45, or three separate raids on his outer extractors (which need no coordination between seats), have won under the defect that each seat priced its own group alone?
The ledger row records the opponent as Armada (the lobby's side), but he played Cortex. Should the row be corrected?
Did the reclaim instruction of 11:26 fail in the decompression (P11 gave follow_list) or in the constructors' queued lists? bot.log shows 0 at work all game.
